title: Claude for Small Product Businesses: Labels, Margins, Reviews
desc: Four no-code Claude workflows for small product sellers: label copy checks, wholesale proposals with margin tables, competitor review analysis and a weekly check.

title: Cut AI Token Costs: Context, Model Split, Caching, Cost Tracking
desc: Practical ways to lower Claude API bills: send only needed documents, split steps across models, cache a project summary and track cost per task. Current prices included.

title: Immich on Proxmox with a ZFS Mirror: Setup and 3-2-1 Backup
desc: Step-by-step Immich photo server on Proxmox: ZFS mirror, VM sizing from the official requirements, Docker Compose install and a 3-2-1 backup that includes database dumps.

title: Mutation Testing False Kills: Baselines, File Access, Kill Reasons
desc: Why mutation scores get inflated by false kills and three checks to catch them: a pristine-copy baseline, proof the mutated file was read, and the kill-reason distribution.

title: 1인+AI로 사이트 만들며 배운 것: 페이지 줄이고 검색 색인 정리하기
desc: 사람 한 명과 Claude Code로 만든 정보 사이트에서 이틀 동안 페이지 3,744개를 863개 수준으로 줄이고 얇은 페이지를 데이터 화면으로 합친 기록과 규칙.
sources: 이 사이트 저장소 커밋 기록(index.html·sitemap.xml 개수)
en_summary: A solo developer and an AI coding agent built a Korean information site and watched the page count balloon to 3,744 as auto-generated pages piled up, while Google Search Console showed zero indexed pages from 691 submitted URLs. In two days the pages were cut to about 863 by deleting old machine-translated language copies and merging thin detail pages into one data view, and the sitemap was trimmed to match. The post lists the exact changes, the numbers (recounted from commit history), and the rules that came out of it.

title: Korea Take-Home Salary 2026: Deductions, Rates and Examples
desc: How a Korean annual salary becomes monthly take-home pay in 2026: pension, health, long-term care, employment insurance and income tax, with official rates and example amounts.
sources: National Health Insurance Service (7.19%, long-term care 0.9448%)
Ministry of Employment and Labor (employment insurance)

title: Jeonse vs Wolse Explained: Protecting Your Deposit as a Foreigner
desc: Jeonse, wolse and ban-jeonse in Korea explained, plus the steps that protect your deposit: address report, fixed date and guarantee insurance, with notes for registered foreigners.
sources: Immigration Act Art. 88-2 (Korean Law Information Center)

title: Unemployment Benefits for Foreigners in Korea (2026)
desc: Which visas are covered by Korean employment insurance, 2026 daily maximum and minimum unemployment benefit, benefit periods and how foreign workers apply.
sources: Ministry of Employment and Labor — employment insurance for foreign workers

title: Korean Contests Open to Foreigners: How to Find and Enter
desc: How to read Korean contest eligibility rules as a foreign resident, plus an hourly-updated list of open Korean contests whose rules mention foreigners.
sources: Official notices linked from each contest page

title: 뉴스 이슈에 「내 생활 영향」과 실제 시세를 붙이는 법 — 규칙표·FRED·SVG로 지어내지 않기
desc: 영향 규칙표 10개로 이슈 60개 중 7개에 생활 영향 카드를 붙이고, FRED·업비트 공개 시세 6개(1.6초)로 전문가 발언 뒤 7일·30일 등락을 사후 확인하는 정적 사이트 파이프라인.
en_summary: How to attach a "what does this mean for my life" card and real market data to news items on a static site without letting an AI invent sentences. Impact text comes only from a hand-written rule table (10 rules, keyword regex plus fixed phrasing), and expert claims are checked against public FRED and Upbit price data 7 and 30 days later, rendered as inline SVG. A daily job caches the market data so the hourly build never calls external APIs.

title: 신규 도메인 백링크·홍보 채널 사흘 실측 정리
desc: 색인 0인 새 도메인에서 dev.to·네이버 블로그·지식iN·레딧·LinuxFr·Product Hunt 6개 채널을 사흘 써 본 실제 유입 숫자와 정지·폐쇄 사례, 정리한 규칙 5개(표본 작음·참고용).
sources: 구글 서치 콘솔 사이트맵 제출·색인 수
en_summary: Three days of real traffic numbers from six promotion channels for a brand-new domain with zero indexed pages (small sample, for reference only). Technical posts with comments on dev.to brought the most visits, Naver blog posts built around search phrases and Q&A answers were next, while a Reddit account and a LinuxFr account were suspended for link-heavy promotion. The post ends with five rules learned the hard way.

title: 윈도우 11에서 wmic가 사라져 예약 작업이 조용히 멈춘 이야기 (파이썬 대체 코드)
desc: 윈도우 11에 wmic가 없어 파이썬 예약 작업이 FileNotFoundError 로 조용히 실패한 원인과, Get-CimInstance·psutil 대체 코드, 점검 실패 시 멈추게 하는 법.
en_summary: A nightly Python job silently stopped working on Windows 11 because the deprecated wmic tool is no longer installed: subprocess raised FileNotFoundError, a try/except swallowed it, and later steps finished as if nothing happened. The fix replaces wmic with PowerShell Get-CimInstance (or psutil), hides the console window, and makes the pre-flight check fail loudly instead of continuing.

title: ffmpeg 한 번에 세로 영상에 「3초 뒤 배너」와 「끝 카드」 붙이기 (파이썬)
desc: ffmpeg filter_complex 한 번으로 세로 영상에 3초부터 나오는 배너와 3.5초 끝 카드를 붙이는 파이썬 코드, enable 쉼표·concat 규격·오디오 채널 실수 3가지.
en_summary: A single ffmpeg filter_complex call that adds a banner starting at 3 seconds and a 3.5-second end card (with matching silent audio) to a finished vertical video, driven from Python. Three mistakes are explained: the comma inside enable=gte(t,3) must be escaped, the concat inputs and audio channels must match in format, and the Python graph string must be a raw string so the backslashes reach ffmpeg.

title: Steam Refund Policy Explained: 14 Days, 2 Hours and How to Request One
desc: Steam's official refund rules in plain English: 14 days and under 2 hours for games, plus DLC, gifts, bundles, pre-purchases, wallet funds and what cannot be refunded.

title: Korea Monthly Rent Tax Credit for Foreign Residents: Eligibility, Rate and Limit
desc: Who can claim the monthly rent tax credit in Korea, the 15-17% rate, the KRW 10 million rent cap, home and address rules, and what foreign residents should check with NTS.
sources: National Tax Service: monthly rent tax credit (Korean)

title: Korea Business Tax Calendar for Sole Proprietors: VAT, Income Tax, Withholding
desc: When individual business owners in Korea file VAT, income tax and withholding tax, plus registration and closing deadlines, from National Tax Service guidance.
sources: National Tax Service: VAT filing deadlines (Korean)
National Tax Service: income tax deadlines (Korean)

title: 방문 집계에 우리 점검 방문이 섞여 수치가 부풀었던 일 — nohit 플래그와 데이터센터 표시로 고친 과정
desc: 하루 방문 214명 중 사람일 가능성이 큰 쪽은 76명이었어요. 링크 확인 방문과 데이터센터 점검 트래픽을 가려낸 규칙, ?nohit=1 플래그, Cloudflare Workers의 ASN·접속 회사 표시, 읽음 신호까지 정리했어요.
en_summary: Our self-built hit counter showed 214 visitors on one day, but only about 76 looked human: the rest were our own link checks and data-center traffic that slipped past a bot-name filter. The fixes were a ?nohit=1 localStorage flag, new columns (browser/OS, ASN, network owner, a data-center flag that marks instead of blocks) filled from request.cf in a Cloudflare Worker, and one read signal (max scroll and seconds on page) updated once per visit. Lesson: store the signals you will need to filter later at write time.

title: 본문 속 「근로기준법 제60조」를 국가법령정보센터 조문으로 자동 링크하기 (정규식과 함정 3가지)
desc: 법령명+제N조 언급을 law.go.kr 조문 주소로 바꾸는 파이썬 코드, 이름 없는 조문의 기본 법 처리, 링크 대조 검사, 그리고 「현행」 조회본이 최신 개정을 빠뜨렸던 사례를 정리했어요.
en_summary: How a static-site build step turns mentions like "Labor Standards Act Article 60" into links to the exact article on law.go.kr (URL pattern /법령/<law name without spaces>/제N조), with a Python regex that skips existing links and scripts and refuses to link when the law name is unknown. A separate check compares every generated link text with its URL (151 links, no mismatches), and one trap is documented: the default "current" version of a statute omitted a promulgated amendment that appeared only under its own version ID.

title: D1 읽기 한도 때문에 방문 통계를 「한 번 읽고 코드에서 묶기」로 바꾼 일
desc: 같은 테이블을 열세 번 훑던 관리자 통계를 최근 7일 행 한 번 읽기, 일별 요약표, 3분 캐시로 바꾼 Cloudflare D1 구조와 코드, 컬럼 이름 명시의 효과를 정리했어요.
en_summary: An admin statistics view on Cloudflare D1 (free tier) ate the daily read budget because it scanned the same hits table thirteen times; D1 bills by rows read, not by queries. The fix reads the last seven days once with explicit column names, groups visitors, channels and pages in Worker memory, keeps older days as one summary row per day, and caches the JSON result for three minutes with a ?fresh=1 escape hatch. Explicit column names later let new columns be added without touching this code.

title: AI 세션 여러 개로 사이트를 돌리며 겪은 사고 네 가지 — 잠금 파일, 3-way 병합, 교차 검증, 승인 전달
desc: 끊긴 빌드가 남긴 잠금 파일로 배포가 조용히 건너뛰어진 일, 두 세션의 변경을 원본 4개만 3-way 병합한 과정, 숫자 교차 대조, 다른 세션이 전한 승인의 범위 해석까지 솔직하게 적었어요.
en_summary: One person runs a site with several AI coding-agent sessions (site code, research and coordination, outbound promotion). Four real incidents and the rules they produced: a stale build lock file made hourly builds skip silently (check the PID in the lock and verify the live page after every deploy); a branch with 1,370 changed files was merged by 3-way merging only the four hand-written sources, never the generated HTML; numbers one session wrote were cross-checked against statute text by another and two were corrected; and an approval relayed by another session was treated as scoped to one change, with backups and a live check.
